bar.rule: the best frontier row held to one answer (bench/ladder.mjs frontierRowOf); met when the solved percent reaches its score on every scored task and on the clean ones

development.what: the ARC-AGI-1 training split: the vocabulary of capability/grid-dsl.mjs was written against it

heldOut.what: the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation split, every task scored; nothing in capability/grid-dsl.mjs was tuned on it (this bench header)

split.contaminated: 1 of the 400 scored evaluation tasks shares a pair with a development task (070dd51e is pair for pair identical to training 40853293), so its score is in sample; the other scored tasks share no train or test pair with the development tasks

decidedFrom.what: every train and test pair of each scored task compared, by the sha256 of its input and output grids, with every train and test pair of the development tasks

clean.what: the scored tasks that share no train or test pair with a development task

notTheBarBecause: a control arm (--fixed-vocab): the search without the fallback phase

published.system: Icecuber (Kaggle, program search over a hand written DSL, no LLM)

statement: On the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation split the grid program search without its fallback phase (the control arm) solved 71 of 400 tasks (17.75 percent) with one attempt per task, no model and a 3000 ms wall clock budget per task, mean 2497.62 ms per task. 1 exhausted the vocabulary, 322 ran out of clock, 6 found a program that fit every train pair and missed a test output. Every solved answer is what a chain of grid.dsl cells emitted after grid.dsl.match cells confirmed every train pair. This is the held out EVALUATION split; the published no-model row is Icecuber (Kaggle, program search over a hand written DSL, no LLM) at 17 percent on the evaluation split. Of the scored tasks, 399 share no train or test pair with a development task, and on those it solved 70 (17.54 percent). Contaminated: 1 of the 400 scored evaluation tasks shares a pair with a development task (070dd51e is pair for pair identical to training 40853293), so its score is in sample; the other scored tasks share no train or test pair with the development tasks. This file is not the bar: a control arm (--fixed-vocab): the search without the fallback phase.
